import logging

from collections import Counter

import torch
from torch import nn

from.models import TransformerLM

logging.basicConfig(
    stream=sys.stdout,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s",

)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = TransformerLM(
        d_model=2048, nhead=8, num_encoder_layers=1, num_decoder_layers=1, dim_feedforward=2048
    )
    model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./models/pytorch_model.bin"))

    print(model)

    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    model.to(device)
    model.eval()

    src_sentence = "The dog barked."
    src_tokens = src_sentence.split()
    src_tokens += ["<eos>"]

    tensor_src_tokens = torch.LongTensor(
        [[model.src_tokenizer.token_to_id(tok) for tok in src_tokens]]
    ).to(device)

    enc_outputs, dec_outputs = model(tensor_src_tokens)
    logits = dec_outputs.data[-1, :, :]

    top_k = min(len(src_tokens), 10)
    probs, tokens = logits[0].topk(top_k)

    selected_tokens = []
    for prob, token in zip(probs, tokens):
        selected_tokens.append(model.tgt_tokenizer.id_to_token(token.item()))

    random.shuffle(selected_tokens)
    for i, tok in enumerate(selected_tokens):
        print(f"{i + 1}: {tok}")
